age.evidence: Animals were 7 -8 weeks old at the start of behavioral studies.

sex.evidence: we used auditory delay fear conditioning and determined the effects of psilocybin on fear extinction, extinction retention, and fear renewal in 112 male and female mice. ... For each drug condition, we tested 4 male and 4 female animals.

dosing.evidence: On day 3, the mouse was given psilocybin (0.5, 1, or 2 mg/kg, i.p.) or saline vehicle. The animal was then placed back in its home cage for 30 min before being moved to context B for fear extinction. ... A stock 4 mg/mL solution was prepared by dissolving solid in 0.9% saline

the mouse received a single i.p. injection of a mixture containing MDL100907 (1 mg/kg ...) ... plus psilocybin (1 mg/kg) or vehicle. MDL100907 was dissolved in a 0.9% saline solution containing 0.3% Tween 80
the mouse received a single i.p. injection of a mixture containing ... WAY100635 (2 mg/kg ...) or vehicle, plus psilocybin (1 mg/kg) or vehicle. WAY100635 was diluted in 0.9% saline

group_housing.evidence: were housed in groups of 4 mice per cage with ad libitum access to food and water.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Mice were kept on a 12 h light/dark cycle (lights on between 08:00 and 16:00 h), with behavioral testing occurring between 08:30 and 13:00 h.

assays.assay_name: Auditory Delay Fear Conditioning / Extinction / Retention / Renewal
assays.assay_description: Med Associates near-infrared video fear conditioning system. Day 1: 3-min habituation + 5 tone (4 kHz, 80 dB, 30 s)–footshock (0.8 mA, 2 s) pairings in context A. Day 3: extinction (3-min habituation + 15 CS-only presentations, 15 s ITI) in context B; Day 4: extinction retention in context B; Day 11: fear renewal in context C. Psilocybin (0.5/1/2 mg/kg i.p.) given 30 min before extinction (main), 30 min before conditioning, or immediately after extinction (variants); antagonist cotreatment (MDL100907, WAY100635) cohort. Measure: % time freezing (VideoFreeze), binned by habituation and CS blocks.

application_type.evidence: Injections, including vehicle controls, were performed intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a volume of 10 mL/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: Prior to each session, mice were brought into a side room separated from the fear conditioning system where they habituated for 30 min. (room acclimation only; within-session 3-min habituation is part of the recorded session)

setup_restrain.evidence: the mouse was individually placed in the conditioning chamber

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the conditioning chamber; home-cage 'ad libitum access to food and water'.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the conditioning chamber; home-cage 'ad libitum access to food and water'.

time_to_assay.evidence: returned to their home cages for 30 min. After this, the mouse was placed in the conditioning chamber prepared in 'context B'; retention on day 4 (~24 h); fear renewal on day 11 (8 days); variants: psilocybin 30 min before conditioning, or immediately after extinction with retention 24 h later.

sample_size.evidence: in 112 male and female mice. ... N = 32, including 4 males and 4 females for vehicle, and 4 males and 4 females for each of the psilocybin conditions. ... N = 64 including 8 males and 8 females for vehicle + vehicle, 8 males and 8 females for vehicle + psilocybin, and 4 males and 4 females each for MDL100907 + vehicle, MDL100907 + psilocybin, WAY100635 + vehicle, and WAY100635 + psilocybin.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (0.5, 1, 2 mg/kg) given 30 min before extinction reduced conditioned freezing during extinction at all doses, but only 1 mg/kg reduced freezing at extinction retention (day 4) and suppressed fear renewal in a novel context (day 11). Psilocybin given before conditioning or immediately after extinction had no effect. MDL100907 (5-HT2A antagonist) blocked effects on retention and renewal, while WAY100635 (5-HT1A antagonist) blocked only the renewal effect; sex x dose interactions suggested females respond to a narrower dose range.
outcomes.statistics: Extinction day 3: main effect of dose F(3,420)=6.223, p<0.001; all doses vs vehicle p<0.001. Retention day 4: dose F(3,420)=4.387, p=0.005; 1 mg/kg vs vehicle p<0.001. Renewal day 11: dose F(3,420)=5.72, p<0.001; 1 mg/kg vs vehicle p=0.001, vs 0.5 p=0.005, vs 2 p=0.022. Sex analysis: extinction sex×dose F(3,360)=3.018, p=0.03; retention dose F(3,360)=5.298, p=0.001; renewal sex×dose×time F(42,360)=1.42, p=0.05. Antagonist study: extinction antagonist×drug F(2,870)=3.604, p=0.028; veh+psi vs veh+veh p=0.002; retention antagonist×psilocybin×time F(28,870)=1.791, p=0.007; veh+psi vs veh+veh p<0.001; WAY+psi vs WAY+veh p=0.025; renewal veh+psi vs veh+veh p=0.002.
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin reduced conditioned freezing (main effect of dose: F3,420 = 6.223, p < 0.001), which was statistically significant for all doses tested compared to vehicle controls ... post hoc analyses revealed only mice previously given 1 mg/kg psilocybin froze less than vehicle controls (p < 0.001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Conditioned freezing was used as the primary readout for behavior and was defined as a lack of detectable movement other than breathing for ≥1 s.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: we binned the data to calculate the freezing responses, where bin 'Hab' corresponds to the 3 min habituation period with no tone, bin 1 corresponds to CS period during tones 1 -3 ...

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions or sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Conditioned freezing was used as the primary readout (conditioned freezing excluded by rubric).

B5_social.evidence: the mouse was individually placed in the conditioning chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: we trained a C57BL/6J mouse to associate an auditory tone (conditioned stimulus; CS) with a noxious foot shock (unconditioned stimulus; US)

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed with automated procedures using the VideoFreeze software from Med Associates Inc. (motion threshold-based; Med Associates on score-0 list)

B8_multivariate.evidence: Generalized linear mixed effects models on freezing only; no dimensionality reduction.

E1_environment_type.evidence: All behavioral testing was conducted in a nearinfrared video fear conditioning system (MED-VFC2-SCT-M, Med Associates Inc.).

E2_shelter.evidence: Contexts described as walls/floor inserts only; no shelter described.

E3_bedding.evidence: metal grid floor [context A] ... white plastic floor [context B] ... striped plastic floor [context C]

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material described in the conditioning chamber.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described in the conditioning chamber.

E6_spatial.evidence: the mouse was individually placed in the conditioning chamber (contexts A/B/C are alternative configurations of a single chamber, not compartments)

E7_social_context.evidence: the mouse was individually placed in the conditioning chamber

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the conditioning chamber.

D1_continuity.evidence: On day 1 of testing (auditory cued fear conditioning) ... On day 3 (fear extinction) ... On day 4 (extinction retention) ... day 11 (fear renewal)

D2_session_duration.evidence: A 3 min habituation period was given, followed by 15 presentations of the CS [30 s] ... separated by a 15 s intertrial interval (≈14 min); conditioning: 3 min + 5 CS with 90 s ITI (≈11.5 min).

D3_recording_days.evidence: Recording on days 1, 3, 4, and 11 = 4 distinct days.

D4_baseline.evidence: Fraction of time spent freezing during different CS presentations during fear conditioning on day 1 ... post hoc analyses did not find any pre-existing difference in freezing between treatment groups prior to injection.

D5_followup.evidence: Psilocybin also exerts long-term effects to elevate extinction retention and suppress fear renewal up to 8 days later (day 4 and day 11 tests).

D6_circadian.evidence: Sessions were ~11–14 min; no session ≥6 h.

judge_notes: All candidates identified a single fear conditioning assay; the dose-response, timing variants (pre-conditioning, post-extinction), and antagonist cohorts were kept as one assay per rubric.
B1 scored 0: two of three candidates gave value '1' (freezing only) but mis-assigned 1 point; rubric maps a single measure to 0 points. Raw_total adjusted to 2... corrected: B2+B6 = 2. See below.
E6 scored 0 (gemma's score of 1 rejected): contexts A/B/C are alternate configurations of a single chamber, not physically distinct compartments.
D3 scored 1 (4 recording days: 1, 3, 4, 11), rejecting gemma's 8-14 which counted calendar span.
application_type set to i.p. (all injections, including antagonist cocktails, were single i.p. injections), rejecting gemma's 'multiple'.

setup_habituation set to 'no' with medium confidence instead of 'yes': the 30-min habituation was in a side room separate from the apparatus (room acclimation), and the 3-min in-chamber habituation is part of the recorded session; strictly 'not_reported' could also apply.
time_to_assay set to 'multiple' (30 min before extinction, ~24 h retention, 8 d renewal).
n_total 112 taken from the paper's explicit statement; figure legend Ns (32 + 16 + 64) are partly ambiguous for the Fig. 3 variants. n_per_group_min = 8 per treatment condition (4M+4F).
Added MDL100907 and WAY100635 dosing entries since the rubric asks for every drug compound administered in behavioural experiments.
